name: material_loop_decompose
description: LP-4e: a forward material pass the project's root declares is decomposed into a loop from the Frame Plan (Decompose into loop..., confirmed), which rewrites it as a render.material_pass and a draw_loop over its materials. The Graph tab comes to the front with the loop selected, and the viewport is the same picture as before. A branch for the box's material that draws nothing takes the box off the screen, and the frame plan says that material took that branch.
